carnatic_plain.label: Carnatic plain and ridge below the Ghats
carnatic_plain.anchor: The dry Carnatic plain below the Western Ghats and its ridge approach: baked earth, dust, a cavalry column toward a notch in the hills and bullock-drawn cannon at its tail. The letter insert belongs to an unnamed rider in this column.
carnatic_plain.absent: No green turbans, red sashes, tropical coast transplanted into the dry plain or identifiable face on the backlit commander.

southern_overlook.label: View south from the Ghats
southern_overlook.anchor: The view south over forested Ghats slopes, homestead pepper gardens, jackfruit and areca, valley paddy, a river and a far-off port. Chanda Sahib's cream turban and shoulder form only the near silhouette, seen from behind.
southern_overlook.absent: No terraces, plantation rows, face turned to camera or close harbour scene.

royal_hall.label: Travancore royal hall
royal_hall.anchor: Varma's Travancore hall, timber pillars, laterite base and a sloping tiled roof. He stands alone in the narrow view with his spear grounded beside him.
royal_hall.absent: No throne, European chair, foreign interior or invented audience in the narrow view.

shrine_steps.label: Small Travancore shrine among coconut palms
shrine_steps.anchor: The steps of a small Travancore shrine with laterite base, sloping tiled roof and coconut palms. When both men are in the panel they sit side by side, Nagoji barefoot with his boots together below the bottom step and his talwar across his knees, Ramayyan's leaf bundle and stylus beside him. Preserve tight hand crops without adding seated full figures.
shrine_steps.absent: No tall gateway tower, chairs, benches or stools. No boots on Nagoji's feet. Outside a specified memory bleed, no cavalry, burning houses or Deccan fields.

village_memory.label: Travancore village in the raid memory
village_memory.anchor: A distant remembered Travancore village of thatched houses burning at dusk, horsemen silhouetted and a family retreating along a bund with bundles. The narration comes from outside the pictured memory.
village_memory.absent: No bodies, blood, identifiable principal or present-day shrine conversation drawn into the village.
village_memory.time: dusk and distant firelight in a softened memory

aramboli_lines.label: Aramboli defensive lines
aramboli_lines.anchor: The Aramboli lines across the neck of a pass: deep ditch, earthen rampart, timber palisade with firing loopholes, sharpened stakes and a timber gate. Tiny sentries stand against the works; the speakers remain outside this view.
aramboli_lines.absent: No masonry castle, towering stone bastions, foreign fort or close foreground observers.

nagercoil_ravine.label: Ravine mouth near Nagercoil
nagercoil_ravine.anchor: The same ravine mouth near Nagercoil in both action and aftermath: red-earth scrub and palmyra, stream-cut rocks, gullies and hills. Open brown ground lies beyond the defensible mouth.
nagercoil_ravine.absent: No green turbans or red sashes on enemy riders, no European fort, no fallen bodies or invented Chanda Sahib among the raiders.

shenkottai_overlook.label: Shenkottai town and pass
shenkottai_overlook.anchor: A high view of Shenkottai, a small walled town at a pass mouth, where green slopes open to flat brown plains and a road enters and leaves the town. The speaking observers remain behind the camera.
shenkottai_overlook.absent: No near foreground figures, imagined palace audience or foreign fortress.

fort_rampart.label: Travancore fort parapet and yard
fort_rampart.anchor: The laterite parapet walk of a Travancore fort, a clay open-wick lamp on the parapet and a tiled doorway lit in the yard below. The parapet faces northeast. The yard conversation stays below the rampart; the panel description determines whether the lamp burns or is being extinguished.
fort_rampart.absent: No glass lantern, foreign bastion or present-day cavalry on the rampart; the Maratha column belongs only to the specified vision.
fort_rampart.time: night, clay lamp and doorway light

coastal_camp.label: Travancore coastal camp
coastal_camp.anchor: The Travancore coastal camp, palm-thatched shelters, horse lines, open cooking grounds and the tiled war hall beyond. The northeast road enters beside the guard position. Soldiers shown at the night fires sit on the ground; only the arrival view and sealed-ola insert include the unnamed courier.
coastal_camp.absent: No European tents or chairs, no invented named courier, no quilted uniform on the messenger, no red-coated troops.

war_hall.label: Travancore coastal war hall
war_hall.anchor: The coastal Travancore war hall, timber pillars and tiled roof, open side toward the sea, brass open-wick lamps, low table with palm leaves and a tray of plain coins. A low dais stands at the front with a place for the spear on its right; the rear pillar stands across the length of the hall from it. Seated chiefs use floor mats; rising chiefs stand from those mats. Show only the cast and current prop positions specified for this panel, without adding earlier or later actions.
war_hall.absent: No throne, European chairs or glass lamps. No turban, crest or headband on Varma, and no turban on any chief, guard or attendant.
war_hall.time: morning, open daylight and brass lamps

beach_rise.label: Low rise above the Travancore coast
beach_rise.anchor: A low rise above the Travancore coast, black sea below, campfires behind and a long empty pale beach. Nagoji stands on this rise in every view of him here; his framing, orientation and movement follow the panel description.
beach_rise.absent: No visible ship hulls, masts or offshore battle. The captive tent belongs only to the separate vision, never on this rise.
beach_rise.time: night, sea wind and campfire smoke

captive_vision.label: Carnatic captive tent in Nagoji's vision
captive_vision.anchor: An imagined captive tent somewhere in the Carnatic: Chanda Sahib sits on a floor mat with iron at his wrists, white jama soiled and cream turban jewel removed, his face hidden in shadow. Maratha officers in white angarkhas and white or saffron pagdis count coin on a floor cloth before him, a saffron swallow-tailed pennant at the doorway.
captive_vision.absent: No Nagoji or coast observer, no clear captive face, no red sash or rust-red turban, no throne or European chair.

page-03-panel-01.bleed: Memory only, with softly bleeding edges, not a clean framed flashback. Ramayyan and Nagoji remain outside this image.

page-03-panel-03.bleed: Behind the present seated Nagoji, softly bleed a dry Deccan field with a farmer and white-clad Maratha riders under a saffron swallow-tailed pennant. Nagoji is not among those memory riders; his barefoot seated shrine profile remains the foreground.

page-04-panel-03.time: last thin gold light on the southeastern ridge

page-04-panel-04.bleed: Only the Aramboli earthworks materialise from the remembered ridgeline, with soft edges. Neither speaking man appears in this view.
page-04-panel-04.lettering_space: Leave generous quiet sky for three off-panel speech areas; keep the ditch, palisade and tiny sentries clear below.

page-05-panel-03.lettering_space: Leave ample open sky for one caption and three off-panel speeches, with tails directed beyond the frame.

page-06-panel-01.bleed: Across the sky only, ghost a column of Maratha horse moving south under saffron swallow-tailed pennants, white angarkhas and white pagdis, long bamboo lances and no red sashes. Keep Nagoji alone on the present parapet.

page-06-panel-02.time: night, the parapet lamp being extinguished while the yard doorway remains lit

page-09-panel-03.lettering_space: Clear upper wall above Nagoji and the listening chiefs, away from his hand and the stack of coins.

page-11-panel-03.bleed: Vision only, softly bleeding across the night sky rather than a clean flashback. Show only the imagined captive tent; no figure from the coastal rise enters it.
page-11-panel-03.lettering_space: Leave low-detail tent shadow above the seated captive and coin-counting hands for two captions.

character_notes.nagoji: Thick curled moustache; clean-shaven chin and jaw, smooth skin, no beard or facial scar. A tiny flush gold ear stud on the lobe with nothing hanging from it.
character_notes.dhanaji: Stockier than Nagoji, short black beard, white Maratha pagdi, indigo quilted tunic, no sash; never a rust-red turban.
character_notes.chanda_sahib: Heavy bearded build, white Mughal jama and high cream turban. Never show a readable face: backlit or seen from behind as a rider, deep shadow as a captive. No red turban or sash; the captive's turban has lost its jewel.
character_notes.varma: Face, moustache and build from his sheet, with black hair, never the grey of the sheet's later figure. On page 1 he wears the sheet's cream-and-gold turban with the peacock-feather crest. In the war hall on pages 5 to 7 he is bare-headed with his hair in a side knot above the LEFT ear: no turban, no crest and no headband, whatever the sheet shows.
